True is supported for declared material method and scenario families after actual main9-27 and Appendix A/B28-29 inspection plus the heading inventory. The study scope is the proposed design and illustrated scenarios; the absence of an empirical heading alone is not used as proof. No source assurance rhetoric or scenario success outcome is released.
